d: No hair or eyes are visible, only a glowing red slit for a gaze within a stylized helmet. The entity appears mature and imposing, possessing a lean, athletic build. It wears a complex, armored outfit consisting of deep navy and crimson fabrics layered under sharp, pale cyan plating. Signature details include a tall, pointed helmet and a large, sweeping, pale cyan energy blade that curves around the body. SPECIES: Armored humanoid entity BODY COLOR: Deep navy and pale cyan LEGS: Plantigrade, encased in pointed, pale cyan armor boots.
